title: Frontend: Find smallest number
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Find smallest number. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values), returning the minimum finite numeric value without sorting or mutation. Reject empty input with Empty array.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Initialize the minimum from the first accepted value and scan once, replacing it whenever a smaller value appears.
alternativeApproaches: Return both minimum value and first index with a deterministic tie rule.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: One item; all positive; all negative.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
